detailed_action: Search the relevant IS number or product through Know Your Standards or Manakonline. If the standard cannot be located, contact the concerned BIS technical department.
required_evidence_or_output: Applicable IS number and product scope
mark_or_certificate: No mark until licence is granted
freshness_note: Product-specific manual, QCO, notification, or current portal rules prevail.

detailed_action: Obtain the relevant Product Manual, including sampling guidance, test equipment, Scheme of Inspection and Testing (SIT), and scope or grouping rules.
required_evidence_or_output: Product Manual, SIT, grouping and marking-fee information
freshness_note: Product-specific manual, QCO, notification, or current portal rules prevail.

detailed_action: Ensure manufacturing infrastructure, process controls, quality control, and testing capability exist for the product and the product can meet all requirements of the IS.
required_evidence_or_output: Factory capability records, QC plan, test facilities
freshness_note: Product-specific manual, QCO, notification, or current portal rules prevail.

detailed_action: Submit the product-certification application and payments online through Manakonline after reviewing portal instructions. Separate applications are required for each product/IS and each factory location.
required_evidence_or_output: Online application, fee payment, factory and product details
freshness_note: Product-specific manual, QCO, notification, or current portal rules prevail.

detailed_action: BIS assesses the manufacturing premises. Depending on the route, conformity is established by BIS or recognized laboratory testing, testing at the manufacturing premises, or a combination.
required_evidence_or_output: Inspection report, test reports, samples, technical records
freshness_note: Product-specific manual, QCO, notification, or current portal rules prevail.

detailed_action: After satisfactory assessment and conformity decision, BIS grants a licence to use the specified Standard Mark within the approved scope.
required_evidence_or_output: Licence with scope, conditions and validity
freshness_note: Product-specific manual, QCO, notification, or current portal rules prevail.

detailed_action: Maintain infrastructure, controls, testing, records, and product conformity. BIS may conduct surprise factory surveillance and market surveillance, including independent sample testing.
required_evidence_or_output: Surveillance records, samples, test results, corrective actions
freshness_note: Product-specific manual, QCO, notification, or current portal rules prevail.

detailed_action: Submit renewal online with production details and applicable fee. Inclusion or deletion of varieties requires the relevant scope-change procedure; do not mark varieties outside the licence scope.
required_evidence_or_output: Renewal or scope-change application, production details, fees
freshness_note: Product-specific manual, QCO, notification, or current portal rules prevail.

detailed_action: Determine whether the product is listed under the CRS register and identify its applicable Indian Standard and product category.
required_evidence_or_output: Applicable IS and CRS product category
freshness_note: Product-specific manual, QCO, notification, or current portal rules prevail.

detailed_action: Test the product through a BIS-recognized laboratory according to the applicable requirements and test format.
freshness_note: Product-specific manual, QCO, notification, or current portal rules prevail.

detailed_action: Compile evidence of conformity and the manufacturer’s declaration under the registration route.
freshness_note: Product-specific manual, QCO, notification, or current portal rules prevail.

detailed_action: Submit the registration application through the official CRS portal with required details and fees.
freshness_note: Product-specific manual, QCO, notification, or current portal rules prevail.

detailed_action: After review and acceptance, obtain the BIS registration number for the manufacturer/product combination.
freshness_note: Product-specific manual, QCO, notification, or current portal rules prevail.

detailed_action: Mark covered products according to the CRS marking requirements and only within the registered scope.
freshness_note: Product-specific manual, QCO, notification, or current portal rules prevail.

detailed_action: Maintain conformity, records, and registration status; use the official CRS portal for inclusion, renewal, or changes.
freshness_note: Product-specific manual, QCO, notification, or current portal rules prevail.

detailed_action: Confirm that the product is listed under Scheme IV and identify the essential requirement and applicable QCO.
official_source_title: BIS Scheme IV Certificate of Conformity
freshness_note: Scheme IV product-specific QCO and essential requirement govern the exact route.

detailed_action: For transformer stampings/laminations/cores, confirm use of BIS Standard Marked electrical steel or the specified conforming materials; for bicycle reflectors, meet the stated clause of the applicable IS.
official_source_title: BIS Scheme IV Certificate of Conformity
freshness_note: Scheme IV product-specific QCO and essential requirement govern the exact route.

detailed_action: Prepare technical, testing, manufacturing, and traceability evidence required by the relevant QCO and product-specific requirements.
official_source_title: BIS Scheme IV Certificate of Conformity
freshness_note: Scheme IV product-specific QCO and essential requirement govern the exact route.

detailed_action: Submit the application through the current BIS conformity-assessment channel with required documents and fees.
official_source_title: BIS Scheme IV Certificate of Conformity
freshness_note: Scheme IV product-specific QCO and essential requirement govern the exact route.

detailed_action: BIS evaluates the evidence and may assess manufacturing and testing arrangements under the applicable conformity-assessment requirements.
official_source_title: BIS Scheme IV Certificate of Conformity
freshness_note: Scheme IV product-specific QCO and essential requirement govern the exact route.

detailed_action: Use the Certificate of Conformity only for the approved product and conditions; maintain conformity and records.
official_source_title: BIS Scheme IV Certificate of Conformity
freshness_note: Scheme IV product-specific QCO and essential requirement govern the exact route.

step_title: Identify the IS and product scope
detailed_action: Search the Indian Standard and confirm the Scheme X product category, specific requirement, QCO, and product-specific guidelines.
freshness_note: Product-specific manual, QCO, notification, or current portal rules prevail.

detailed_action: Prepare the Technical File covering design, manufacture, and operation as applicable and necessary to demonstrate conformity.
freshness_note: Product-specific manual, QCO, notification, or current portal rules prevail.

detailed_action: Maintain manufacturing infrastructure, in-process controls, quality control, and testing capabilities for the relevant IS.
freshness_note: Product-specific manual, QCO, notification, or current portal rules prevail.

detailed_action: Use BIS-recognized laboratories, manufacturing-premises testing, or an approved combination, as applicable to the product.
freshness_note: Product-specific manual, QCO, notification, or current portal rules prevail.

detailed_action: Submit the Scheme X application through the applicable BIS portal with Technical File and required fees. Separate applications/certifications apply to separate factory locations; separate licences apply to different products/IS.
freshness_note: Product-specific manual, QCO, notification, or current portal rules prevail.

detailed_action: BIS assesses the manufacturing infrastructure and controls and establishes product conformity through the applicable testing and evaluation.
freshness_note: Product-specific manual, QCO, notification, or current portal rules prevail.

detailed_action: On successful assessment, obtain the licence to use the Standard Mark within the approved scope and conditions.
freshness_note: Product-specific manual, QCO, notification, or current portal rules prevail.

detailed_action: Support BIS surveillance, preserve records and test capability, and only mark approved products within scope.
required_evidence_or_output: Surveillance evidence and continued licence validity
freshness_note: Product-specific manual, QCO, notification, or current portal rules prevail.

detailed_action: Apply online for jeweller registration through Manakonline before sending articles to an Assaying and Hallmarking Centre.
freshness_note: Hallmarking rules, mandatory orders, and current charges must be checked live.

step_title: Send articles to recognized A&H centre
detailed_action: Only a BIS-registered/certified jeweller can approach an A&H centre for hallmarking of jewellery.
freshness_note: Hallmarking rules, mandatory orders, and current charges must be checked live.

detailed_action: The recognized centre assays the articles and applies the applicable hallmark components according to the governing IS and BIS requirements.
freshness_note: Hallmarking rules, mandatory orders, and current charges must be checked live.

detailed_action: Ensure each applicable article and detachable part has the required hallmark details and HUID; retain accurate article and invoice records.
freshness_note: Hallmarking rules, mandatory orders, and current charges must be checked live.

detailed_action: BIS may audit A&H centres and draw market samples from registered/certified jewellers for referral-laboratory testing.
